mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (user_id, match_type, match_id, title, content, image, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{matchType}, #{matchId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{image}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: select r.*,u.nickname, u.profile_image from review r join user u on u.user_id=r.user_id where r.deleted=false order by r.created_at desc limit ?,?;

SELECT 'PERSONAL' AS matchType, m.personal_match_id AS matchId, m.title AS title FROM personal_match_participant p JOIN personal_match m ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = '결제완료' AND m.deleted = '0' AND m.status = '경기 종료' AND p.attendance = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.match_type = 'PERSONAL' AND r.match_id = m.personal_match_id AND r.deleted = 0) ORDER BY m.match_date DESC

SELECT 'TEAM' AS matchType, m.team_match_id AS matchId, m.title AS title FROM team_match_participant p JOIN team_match m ON m.team_match_id = p.team_match_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = '결제완료' AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = '경기 종료' AND p.attendance = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.match_type = 'TEAM' AND r.match_id = m.team_match_id AND r.deleted = 0) ORDER BY m.match_date DESC
